<title>🌈 Flow Free</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0f172a;color:#e2e8f0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;overscroll-behavior:none}
#app{height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 10px env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
header{width:100%;max-width:720px;height:52px;flex:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 1fr 96px;align-items:center}
header h1{font-size:18px;margin:0;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}
#lv{text-align:right;font-weight:700;color:#fbbf24;font-size:14px}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.b{background:#334155;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.b:active{transform:scale(.95)}.b.on{background:#6366f1}
section{width:100%;flex:1;min-height:0}
#menu{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow-y:auto}
#sub{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px;color:#94a3b8}
.hp{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:#94a3b8;text-align:center;max-width:640px}
#grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);gap:5px}
#grid button{border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:0;min-width:0}
#grid .done{background:#16a34a}#grid .cur{background:#f59e0b;color:#111}#grid .lock{background:#1e293b;color:#475569;cursor:default}
#play{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;max-width:720px;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden}

<div id="app">
<header><button class="b" id="bk" style="visibility:hidden">☰ Màn</button><h1>🌈 Flow Free</h1><span id="lv"></span></header>
<section id="menu"><p id="sub"></p><div id="grid"></div><p class="hp">Nối các cặp chấm cùng màu bằng đường đi không cắt nhau, và phải phủ kín toàn bộ lưới.</p></section>
<section id="play" hidden><div id="info"></div><div id="board"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="ctl"></div></section>
<div id="md" hidden><div class="box"><h2 id="mt"></h2><p id="mx"></p><div id="mb"></div></div></div>
</div>
<script>
const GAME={key:'flow'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const qs=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{qs('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{qs('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=qs('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();qs('#play').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';qs('#lv').textContent='';
 qs('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 qs('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=true;qs('#play').hidden=false;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='visible';qs('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){qs('#mt').textContent=t;qs('#mx').textContent=x;const m=qs('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});qs('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
qs('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
qs('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

const FC=['#ef4444','#3b82f6','#22c55e','#eab308','#a855f7','#f97316','#06b6d4','#ec4899','#84cc16','#e2e8f0'];
let n,k,ends,ep,paths,own,ac,svg;
function gen(l){
 const R=rng(l*5171+9);n=5+Math.floor((l-1)/20);const p=((l-1)%20)/19,kmin=Math.ceil(n*.6),kmax=n+1;k=Math.round(kmin+(kmax-kmin)*p);k=Math.min(k,FC.length);
 const N=n*n;let h=[];for(let y=0;y<n;y++)for(let x=0;x<n;x++)h.push(y*n+(y%2?n-1-x:x));
 for(let it=0;it<N*30;it++){
  if(R()<.5)h.reverse();
  const e=h[N-1],ex=e%n,ey=e/n|0,nb=[];
  for(const[dx,dy]of[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const x=ex+dx,y=ey+dy;if(x<0||y<0||x>=n||y>=n)continue;const j=h.indexOf(y*n+x);if(j<N-2)nb.push(j)}
  if(nb.length){const j=nb[R()*nb.length|0];h=h.slice(0,j+1).concat(h.slice(j+1).reverse())}
 }
 const len=Array(k).fill(3);for(let e=N-3*k;e>0;e--)len[R()*k|0]++;
 ends=[];let s=0;for(let c=0;c<k;c++){ends.push([h[s],h[s+len[c]-1]]);s+=len[c]}
}
function start(l){
 gen(l);ep={};ends.forEach((e,c)=>{ep[e[0]]=c;ep[e[1]]=c});paths=ends.map(()=>[]);ac=-1;recalc();
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='fl';b.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 '+n+' '+n+'"></svg>';svg=b.firstChild;
 b.onpointerdown=e=>{if(over)return;const i=cell(e);if(i<0)return;b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  if(ep[i]!==undefined){ac=ep[i];paths[ac]=[i]}else if(own[i]>=0){ac=own[i];const p=paths[ac];paths[ac]=p.slice(0,p.indexOf(i)+1)}else return;
  recalc();draw()};
 b.onpointermove=e=>{if(ac<0)return;const t=cell(e);if(t<0)return;
  for(let g=0;g<20&&ac>=0;g++){const p=paths[ac],tail=p[p.length-1];if(tail==t)break;const tx=t%n,ty=t/n|0,x=tail%n,y=tail/n|0;let nx=x,ny=y;if(tx!=x)nx+=Math.sign(tx-x);else ny+=Math.sign(ty-y);if(!step(ny*n+nx))break}
  draw()};
 b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=()=>{if(ac<0)return;ac=-1;draw();check()};
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='<button class="b" id="r">🔄 Làm lại</button>';qs('#ctl').onclick=()=>{if(!over)play(L)};
 relayout();draw();say('Kéo từ một chấm màu tới chấm cùng màu. Phải phủ kín mọi ô!');
}
function cell(e){const r=qs('#board').getBoundingClientRect(),x=Math.floor((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*n),y=Math.floor((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*n);return x<0||y<0||x>=n||y>=n?-1:y*n+x}
function recalc(){own=Array(n*n).fill(-1);paths.forEach((p,c)=>p.forEach(i=>own[i]=c))}
function done(c){const p=paths[c],t=p[p.length-1];return p.length>1&&t!=p[0]&&ep[t]===c}
function step(x){
 const p=paths[ac],Ln=p.length;
 if(Ln>1&&p[Ln-2]==x){p.pop();recalc();return true}
 if(done(ac))return false;
 if(ep[x]!==undefined&&ep[x]!=ac)return false;
 const ix=p.indexOf(x);
 if(ix>=0){if(ix==0)return false;paths[ac]=p.slice(0,ix+1);recalc();return true}
 if(own[x]>=0&&own[x]!=ac){const o=own[x];paths[o]=paths[o].slice(0,paths[o].indexOf(x))}
 p.push(x);recalc();return true}
function relayout(){const b=qs('#board');if(b.classList.contains('fl'))b.style.width=b.style.height=Math.floor(side(0))+'px'}
function draw(){
 let s='<g stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width=".03">';for(let i=1;i<n;i++)s+='<path d="M'+i+' 0V'+n+'M0 '+i+'H'+n+'"/>';s+='</g>';
 paths.forEach((p,c)=>{const col=FC[c];p.forEach(i=>s+='<rect x="'+i%n+'" y="'+(i/n|0)+'" width="1" height="1" fill="'+col+'" opacity=".2"/>');
  if(p.length>1)s+='<polyline fill="none" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width=".42" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" points="'+p.map(i=>(i%n+.5)+','+((i/n|0)+.5)).join(' ')+'"/>'});
 ends.forEach((e,c)=>e.forEach(i=>s+='<circle cx="'+(i%n+.5)+'" cy="'+((i/n|0)+.5)+'" r=".3" fill="'+FC[c]+'"/>'));
 svg.innerHTML=s;
 setInfo('Đã nối: '+ends.filter((_,c)=>done(c)).length+'/'+k+' · Phủ: '+own.filter(x=>x>=0).length+'/'+n*n+' ô');
}
function check(){
 if(!ends.every((_,c)=>done(c)))return;
 if(own.every(x=>x>=0))win('Đã nối tất cả và phủ kín lưới!');
 else say('Đã nối hết các cặp nhưng còn ô trống. Hãy uốn đường đi để phủ kín mọi ô.');
}

menu();
</script></body></html>
